title: Cyber Y2K · 记忆里的未来

texts.title: A Future Built from Edges
paragraphs: P1

Look first at Orbital Silence, our original card inspired by a Courrèges reference. The white dress has a fitted silhouette, while its high neckline and angular panels give the body a structured outline. The shape does not depend on a large print. Instead, the edges do much of the visual work.
先看以 Courrèges 为参考设计的原创卡「轨道静默」。白裙廓形贴体，高领与棱角分割构成明确的结构。造型不靠大面积印花，而让边缘承担主要视觉作用。
P2

Now compare the shoulder cape with the boots. The cape is translucent: light passes through it, and the body remains partly visible. The metallic boots reflect light from a more solid surface. This contrast in texture makes the outfit interesting even though its colours stay close to white, blue and silver.
再比较肩罩与靴子：肩罩半透明，光线可以穿过，身体仍部分可见；金属光泽的靴子则从更实的表面反光。即使颜色集中在白、蓝、银，质感对比仍让造型有趣。
P3

Calling the look futuristic is a visual interpretation, not a claim that these clothes contain new technology. The card changes the reference into a short geometric dress and a separate cape. To describe it precisely, name a shape, a material effect and the relationship between them. “Shiny” alone tells us very little.
“未来感”是视觉判断，不代表衣服含有新科技。卡面将参考转译为几何短裙与独立肩罩。精确描述需要指出形状、材质效果及其关系，只有“闪亮”远远不够。
texts.kind: 本节原创读图课文；品牌原图供对照

texts.title: Denim Has More Than One Voice
paragraphs: P1

In Distorted Frequency, a cropped jacket and wide trousers create a layered denim outfit. The shoulders look oversized, but the jacket ends above the waist. That short length matters. It keeps the upper half compact while the trousers carry most of the volume. Changing one length can change the proportion of the whole look.
「失真频段」把短夹克与阔腿裤组合成层叠丹宁。肩部宽大，夹克却在腰线上方结束；上半身因此紧凑，体积主要交给裤子。改变一处长度，就能改变全身比例。
P2

The washed surface contains pale and dark areas. Curved seams lead the eye down the legs, while metal hardware gives small points of emphasis. A washed effect describes a surface treatment; frayed describes loose threads along an edge. They are related to a worn appearance, but they do not mean the same thing. Do not call every pale patch a hole.
洗水表面有深浅区域，弧形接缝引导视线向下，金属配件提供小焦点。washed 指表面处理，frayed 指边缘松散线头，二者都可能呈现旧感，但意思不同；浅色斑块不等于破洞。
P3

The card takes a Diesel reference as a starting point, then changes the jacket length, waist construction and panel lines. Its small music device suggests a personal story. It does not prove that the exact outfit existed in the year 2000. Describe what you can see before giving the clothes a date.
卡面从 Diesel 参考出发，改变衣长、腰部结构与分割线。小型音乐设备提供故事线索，却不能证明整套衣服真实存在于 2000 年。先描述可见细节，再判断年代。
texts.kind: 本节原创读图课文；品牌原图供对照

texts.title: A Softer Version of the Future
paragraphs: P1

Liquid Echo offers a different answer to the same theme. Its lilac dress is draped around the body, with an asymmetric hem that extends on one side. A sheer sleeve makes one arm look lighter, while the other side uses an open knitted layer. The outline feels fluid rather than rigid.
「液态回声」给同一主题另一种答案：淡紫裙以垂褶围绕身体，不对称下摆在一侧延长。一侧透视袖使手臂轻盈，另一侧采用镂空针织层，轮廓流动而非僵硬。
P2

Metallic platform sandals add weight below the delicate fabric. The background has an iridescent effect, shifting between blue and pink. Be careful with your description: the coloured glass behind the model does not prove that the dress itself changes colour. A scene can suggest a material effect without every garment sharing it.
金属光泽厚底凉鞋在轻薄裙料下方增加重量。背景在蓝粉之间变色，呈现虹彩效果；但背景玻璃的颜色，不能证明裙子本身也会变色。场景与服装的材质需要分别判断。
P3

This is an original interpretation developed from a Blumarine reference, not a copied runway look. It uses a softer proportion than the first card and a different surface from the denim outfit. The three cards belong together because they explore a shared idea through different shapes, not because they wear identical colours.
这套是从 Blumarine 参考发展出的原创转译。它比第一张更柔软，表面也不同于丹宁。三张卡通过不同形状探索同一想法，关联不依赖完全相同的颜色。
texts.kind: 本节原创读图课文；品牌原图供对照

texts.title: The Past Inside the Future
paragraphs: P1

A fashion revival is not a time machine. People can borrow an older visual language while changing the cut, fabric and way an outfit is worn. Nostalgia describes the feeling attached to the past; revival describes a return to popularity. One is an emotion, while the other is a change in fashion.
时尚复兴不是时光机。人们借用过去的视觉语言，同时改变剪裁、面料与穿法。nostalgia 是对过去的情绪，revival 是重新流行；一个是感受，一个是时尚的变化。
P2

Our three cards make this distinction useful. Orbital Silence depends on a structured shape and a contrast between translucent and metallic surfaces. Distorted Frequency uses washed denim, curved seams and an oversized upper outline. Liquid Echo replaces that weight with fluid, draped fabric and an asymmetric hem. Their differences are part of the chapter, not mistakes to remove.
三张卡让这种区别有了具体对象：「轨道静默」依靠结构及半透明与金属表面的对比；「失真频段」使用洗水丹宁、弧形接缝与宽肩；「液态回声」改用流动垂褶与不对称下摆。差别本身就是本节内容。
P3

Imagine choosing a caption for the collection. “Three silver outfits from 2000” would be inaccurate: the designs are new and the colours differ. A stronger caption would explain how each outfit builds its own version of a remembered future. In fashion English, a convincing interpretation starts with visible evidence and keeps historical claims separate from invented scenes.
如果为整组写文案，“三套来自 2000 年的银色服装”并不准确：设计是新的，颜色也不同。更好的说明是，每套如何构建记忆中的未来。可靠的时尚表达从可见证据出发，将历史事实与创作场景分开。
texts.kind: 本节原创比较阅读；公开文章为延伸阅读

items.reference_scope_zh: 参考2024秋冬系列的包裹轮廓；重设衣长、领口和分割线。
items.body_en: The fitted mini dress creates a narrow silhouette. Its high neckline and geometric panels give the bodice a structured appearance. Fitted describes how closely it follows the body; structured describes how clearly the shape is held.
items.body_zh: 贴体短裙构成窄长廓形，高领与几何拼片让衣身呈现明确结构。fitted 强调贴体程度，structured 强调保形的结构感。
items.focus_zh: 先看全身外轮廓，再看领口和拼片；不要把“贴身”与“有结构”当成同义词。

practice.prompt: Which phrase describes the dress’s overall outline?
practice.explanation: silhouette 指整体廓形，fitted 描述贴体。

items.reference_scope_zh: 肩罩为原创外层，增加几何边缘与轻薄层次。
items.body_en: The translucent capelet lets light pass through, so the arms remain partly visible. Its light texture contrasts with the solid-looking boots. Here, contrast comes from different surface effects rather than strongly different colours.
items.body_zh: 半透明肩罩让光线穿过，手臂仍部分可见。轻薄质感与靴子较实的表面形成对比；这里的 contrast 来自表面效果，而非强烈色差。
items.focus_zh: 看肩罩与手臂重叠的位置，观察透光与不透光的差别。

practice.prompt: The arm remains partly visible because the capelet is ___.
practice.explanation: 透光并保留部分身体可见度，对应 translucent。

items.reference_scope_zh: 参考修长靴筒比例；银色、方头和跟型重新设计。
items.body_en: The metallic boots reflect light from a smooth surface. Their long shafts extend the silhouette below the short dress. Metallic describes a visual finish; it does not mean the entire boot is made from solid metal.
items.body_zh: 金属光泽长靴从光滑表面反光，长靴筒延伸了短裙下方的廓形。metallic 描述视觉表面，不等于整只靴子由实心金属制成。
items.focus_zh: 观察靴筒上的亮暗条带，与肩罩的透光作对比。

practice.prompt: Does “metallic boots” prove that the boots are solid metal?
practice.answer: No. It describes their visual finish.
options: Yes. It names their full composition.
No. It describes their visual finish.
Yes. Every reflective material is metal.
practice.explanation: metallic 在这里是表面视觉效果，不能据此断定成分。

items.reference_scope_zh: 月牙包及发饰为原创几何配件。
items.body_en: The small bag repeats the curved lines of the outfit without adding a large new shape. Its metallic surface connects it to the boots. Repetition can hold a look together, while a contrast in texture keeps the pieces from becoming identical.
items.body_zh: 小包重复整套的弧线，不新增大体积；金属光泽与长靴呼应。重复可以让造型统一，而质感对比让各件不至于完全相同。
items.focus_zh: 看小包与长靴的相似表面，再比较包与肩罩的差别。

practice.prompt: What connects the bag visually to the boots?
practice.explanation: 两者以金属光泽呼应，衣长和毛边不是这里的联系。

items.reference_scope_zh: 参考2024秋冬洗水丹宁与宽肩语言；长外层改为短款并重画拼片。
items.body_en: The cropped denim jacket has oversized shoulders and a washed finish. Pale areas describe the surface treatment. A distressed effect can suggest wear, but washed denim does not necessarily have a frayed edge: frayed specifically means loose threads along an edge.
items.body_zh: 短丹宁夹克采用宽肩和洗水表面，浅色区域体现处理效果。distressed 可以表示做旧，但 washed 不一定带 frayed 毛边；frayed 特指边缘松散的线头。
items.focus_zh: 本图重点是深浅洗水与肩部体积，不把浅色区域说成破洞，也不凭空描述毛边。

practice.prompt: Which detail is clearly used to describe this jacket?
practice.answer: oversized shoulders and a washed finish
options: oversized shoulders and a washed finish
practice.explanation: 介绍明确指出宽肩和洗水；没有说它有透明针织衣身或长拖尾。

items.name_en: Wide-leg trousers with an angled waistband
items.reference_scope_zh: 参考丹宁套装，新增斜腰头与弧形裤腿分割。
items.body_en: The wide-leg trousers carry more volume than the short jacket. An angled waistband and curved seams guide the eye across the hips and down the legs. The buckle is hardware: a small metal fastening, not a type of fabric.
items.body_zh: 阔腿裤承担比短夹克更大的体积。斜腰头与弧形接缝引导视线经过胯部并向下移动；buckle 是 hardware 金属配件，不是一种布料。
items.focus_zh: 从腰头一路看向裤脚，跟随弧形接缝理解版型。

practice.prompt: Which detail joins the fabric panels along the leg?
practice.explanation: seam 是布片相接的接缝；鞋底与袖子不是裤腿分割。

items.name_en: Fitted lilac vest with lime trim
items.reference_scope_zh: 背心为原创内层，用轻薄色块平衡重丹宁。
items.body_en: The fitted vest sits close to the body under the oversized jacket. This layered outfit uses a small, bright inner piece to balance the heavier denim. The contrast is about fit, colour and texture at the same time.
items.body_zh: 贴体背心位于宽大夹克内侧。层叠造型用小而明亮的内层平衡较重的丹宁，同时在贴合度、颜色与肌理上形成对比。
items.focus_zh: 比较背心与夹克的宽窄，理解 layered 不只是“多穿一件”。

practice.prompt: Why does the fitted vest work with the oversized jacket?
practice.answer: It creates a contrast in fit and volume.
options: It creates a contrast in fit and volume.
It makes both pieces equally wide.
practice.explanation: 贴体内层与宽大外层形成体积和贴合度的对照。

items.reference_scope_zh: 鞋履为原创方头厚底；播放器同为原创道具。
items.body_en: A thick platform sole gives the shoes visual weight below the wide trousers. The metallic toe area echoes the outfit’s hardware. The sole belongs to the shoe’s structure, while metallic describes a surface effect.
items.body_zh: 厚底在阔腿裤下方增加视觉重量，鞋头金属光泽呼应服装配件。sole 属于鞋的结构，metallic 则描述表面效果。
items.focus_zh: 把“厚底的形状”与“银色反光的表面”分开描述。

practice.explanation: 厚底是结构，金属光泽是表面效果。

items.reference_scope_zh: 参考2023春夏流动轮廓；紫色、单侧袖与短裙比例重新设计。
items.body_en: The lilac dress is draped around the body, and its asymmetric hem extends on one side. The fabric looks fluid because the folds continue into a moving tail. The short front and longer side create a deliberate proportion rather than a cutting mistake.
items.body_zh: 淡紫裙以垂褶围绕身体，不对称下摆在一侧延长。褶皱延伸成流动裙尾；前短侧长是有意的比例设计，并非裁剪失误。
items.focus_zh: 顺着腰部褶皱看到侧边裙尾，再比较左右长度。

practice.answer: One side extends farther than the other.
options: One side extends farther than the other.
The fabric is made of denim.
Both sides have exactly the same length.
practice.explanation: asymmetric 指左右不对称，这里体现在下摆长度差。

items.name_en: Sheer sleeve and open-knit arm layer
items.reference_scope_zh: 薄纱与镂空语言来自系列研究；独立袖套为重新组合。
items.body_en: One arm is covered by a sheer sleeve; the other uses an open knit layer with visible gaps. Both reveal part of the arm, but their textures are different. Sheer describes the transparent effect, while knit names a textile construction.
items.body_zh: 一侧手臂覆轻薄透视袖，另一侧是带可见空隙的镂空针织层。两者都露出部分手臂，肌理却不同；sheer 描述透视效果，knit 指针织结构。
items.focus_zh: 看两侧袖层怎样露出手臂，不把所有透视面料都叫针织。

practice.prompt: Do “sheer” and “knit” describe exactly the same property?
practice.answer: No. One is a visual effect; the other is textile construction.
options: No. One is a visual effect; the other is textile construction.
Yes. Both mean a very long hem.
practice.explanation: 透视是视觉属性，针织是织物结构，不能互相替代。

items.reference_scope_zh: 凉鞋的厚底、踝带与色彩为原创设计。
items.body_en: The metallic sandals add a firm base below the fluid skirt. Their platform soles change the proportion of the lower body, while the narrow straps leave the feet visible. The contrast between heavy soles and light fabric is a design choice.
items.body_zh: 金属光泽凉鞋在流动裙摆下形成稳定基座，厚底改变下半身比例，细带露出脚部。重鞋底与轻布料的对比是一种设计选择。
items.focus_zh: 比较脚下厚底的重量感与身侧薄纱的轻盈。

practice.prompt: Which contrast does the description emphasise?
practice.explanation: 介绍强调厚底与轻薄裙料的重量感对比。

items.name_en: Silver mini bag and double-bun hairstyle
items.reference_scope_zh: 小包、发髻和发饰为原创；不作为品牌原款或历史穿着记录。
items.body_en: The small silver bag and playful hair styling can suggest nostalgia, but they do not prove a date. A revival means a style returns to popularity; nostalgia is a feeling about the past. The background has an iridescent effect, but the silver bag is described here only as metallic.
items.body_zh: 银色小包与活泼发型可以暗示怀旧，却不能证明年代。revival 是风格重新流行，nostalgia 是对过去的感受。背景有虹彩效果，这只银包在这里仅描述为 metallic 金属光泽。
items.focus_zh: 观察包、发饰与背景，区分情绪联想、趋势变化和真实可见的表面。

practice.prompt: Which sentence is supported by this description?
practice.answer: The scene may evoke nostalgia, but it does not prove a historical date.
options: The scene may evoke nostalgia, but it does not prove a historical date.
Every silver object must change colour with the viewing angle.
The bag proves the exact outfit was worn in 2000.
practice.explanation: 怀旧是联想，不是年代证据；银色反光也不自动等于虹彩变色。
